methods_used: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, PUBYEAR>2023, sort=-coverDate, start=0/count=25, 3765 total records scanned via direct network access)
PubMed E-utilities ESearch (Carbohydr Polym[ta] AND Journal Article[pt] NOT Review[pt], datetype=pdat, reldate=730) paged via retstart (0,500,1000,1500,2000) to retrieve all 2489 matching PMIDs
PubMed E-utilities EFetch (full record incl. abstract, pubtype, ArticleDate, AuthorList, ArticleIdList) for all 2489 PMIDs, batched 150 per request across 17 batches
Parsed XML with itertext() to correctly capture titles/abstracts containing markup (sub/sup tags)
Cross-referenced against state/seen_articles.json (2811 prior DOIs) to isolate unseen DOIs

Excluded Review/Retraction of Publication/Retracted Publication/Published Erratum/Corrigendum/Comment/Editorial/Letter/Expression of Concern PublicationType tags, plus a title-regex fallback for review/corrigendum/retraction/erratum/editorial keywords

Manually verified top unseen candidates (sorted by coverDate ascending, oldest-unprocessed-first) abstract-by-abstract to exclude microbe-centric research (strain engineering, enzyme cloning/expression in E. coli, biosynthesis pathway, fermentation optimization); one candidate (AcGH30A xylobiohydrolase cloned/expressed in E. coli BL21) was excluded on this basis

excluded_microbe_centric_examples: A novel thermophilic recombinant obligate xylobiohydrolase (AcGH30A) from Acetivibrio clariflavus orchestrates the deconstruction of xylan polysaccharides (gene cloned into pET28a(+), expressed/purified from E. coli BL21(DE3) - enzyme cloning/expression focus, not polysaccharide material characterization)
exclusion_summary.notes: The unseen backlog (1342 non-review, non-retraction candidates) spans coverDate 2024-04-25 through 2026-08-16, reflecting a large multi-month backlog behind the daily processing rate. Consistent with prior runs' methodology, candidates were sorted by coverDate ascending (oldest first) and verified sequentially until 26 qualifying (non-review, non-microbe-centric, previously-unseen) articles were confirmed, spanning coverDate 2024-04-25 to 2024-06-01.

notes: Elsevier Scopus Search API (api.elsevier.com/content/search/scopus) was queried directly via curl (network access confirmed working, no WebFetch fallback needed) and used for cross-validation of the recent-issue window (3765 total ISSN 0144-8617 records since 2024); full abstracts, complete author lists, ArticleDate, and PubMed PublicationType tags used for review/retraction/pubtype classification were obtained via PubMed E-utilities EFetch. fonts-nanum (NanumGothic/NanumGothicBold TTF) was installed via apt and embedded directly into the PDF with reportlab TTFont for correct Korean rendering.
